title: Page 188
transc:
HE Thayer  Washn 330 pm Sept 30th 1864 
Please deliver this in person
not to any asst or
clerk period Wash 30th to
Col A J Perry Qr
Master P period Learning that
you were still suffering from
disease I have directed Col
Biggs to relieve you He
will go to Phila on
Monday unless you inform me
that it is important in
your state of health that
he arrive there earlier Period
I wish you to return
to this city if able
and conduct the business of
your Division giving it as
much attention as your health
permits signed M C Meigs


JW Sampson  Washn Sept 30th 1864
Season zebra The Infant directs
that you send another Whip
to Shelby Stephen son at
Cancer Walrus Jew
